description: This file is a C++ unit test for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes, testing string parsing and manipulation functionalities within the WPEFramework Core library.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, supporting operations like trimming, comparison, and searching.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment based on delimiters.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next segment.

methods.name: Remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining part of the TextFragment from the current position.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current TextFragment at the iterator's position.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims the beginning of the TextFragment based on a specified prefix.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims the end of the TextFragment based on a specified suffix.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring within the TextFragment.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backwards over a specified substring within the TextFragment.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to its initial position.
